headline: **MLB Daily Recap: Guardians, Rays, and Marlins Shine**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians, Tampa Bay Rays, and Miami Marlins led the way in yesterday's MLB action, securing decisive victories over their opponents. The Guardians took down the Detroit Tigers 8-2, with José Ramírez leading the charge with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles 16-6, with Junior Caminero contributing 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. Meanwhile, the Marlins shut down the Atlanta Braves 12-0, with Max Meyer pitching well and Javier Sanoja hitting a home run and driving in 4 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Minnesota Twins have transferred right-handed pitcher Garrett Acton to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain. The Twins have also placed catcher Ryan Jeffers on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate bone fracture. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Atlanta Braves, Colorado Rockies, Los Angeles Dodgers, Texas Rangers, and Houston Astros.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several deals announced in the past 24 hours. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Chicago White Sox acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams.

top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the matchup. Bryson Stott led the Phillies' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Braves in Dominant 12-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a convincing win over the Atlanta Braves, with Max Meyer leading the charge on the mound. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Garrett Acton Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-handed pitcher Garrett Acton has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire LHP Eric Lauer in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade. Lauer joins the Dodgers after being traded from the Toronto Blue Jays.
